title: orders-api error-rate SLO burn
description: Customers report failed or very slow checkouts. orders-api shows elevated latency and intermittent 5xx responses.
root_cause_detail: Cross-zone network degradation between orders-api and inventory-service pushed call latency beyond the 1500ms timeout; inventory-service itself was healthy.
expected_symptoms: orders-api downstream_latency_ms rises from ~81ms to ~1.6s (client timeout 1500ms)
timeout and retry logs on calls from orders-api to inventory-service
orders-api p95 latency rises to ~1.5s, error rate up to ~4.8%
orders-api CPU and memory stay near baseline
inventory-service server-side latency normal while caller-observed latency is high
resolution: Routed traffic to same-zone endpoints until the cloud provider fixed the network issue.
